description: Defines the internal structure and methods for a media player implementation, including sample writing, media info updates, and configuration management.

classes.name: SbPlayerPrivate
classes.description: Internal class managing media player state, sample processing, and configuration.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new player instance with specified codecs and callback functions.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks the media to a specified timestamp.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Writes media samples to the player for processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream for a given media type.

methods.name: SetBounds
methods.description: Sets display bounds for video rendering.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for rendering.

methods.name: GetAudioConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves audio configuration at a specified index.
